title: PHerc0211 fits, z [8000, 9000): model-free CT check and audit (published recipe fit, winding-model refits CW and ACW)
notes: Audits every attached fit and the published recipe fit of the same band (armando-gaona, cloned) with the same tools. First, for each fit, a block of 16 windings as fitted and after tools/phase_align.py (crest mode: to the nearest crest of the CT, period 17 voxels) moves them onto the sheets: model-free CT check (sheet_hits.py), gaps between consecutive windings, share of the surface in voids. Then agreement with the winding model on held-out rays, winding pitch, render contrast and full-resolution cross-sections. The refits with the two spiral senses (CW, ACW) are compared: a fit of the wrong sense cannot follow the sheets around a whole turn.
